description: This file defines an Orleans grain interface and implementation for managing leases on stream provider queues, including methods for acquiring, renewing, releasing leases, and tracking responsibility for load balancing in a distributed streaming system.

classes.name: ILeaseManagerGrain
classes.description: Interface for a lease manager grain that handles queue leasing operations for stream providers.

classes.name: LeaseManagerGrain
classes.description: Implementation of the lease management grain, handling lease acquisition, renewal, release, and responsibility tracking.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain, setting up dependencies and internal state upon activation.

methods.name: GetLeaseResposibility
methods.description: Calculates and returns the responsibility count based on current leases and silo statuses.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Finds and assigns an unclaimed lease to the caller.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Renews the lease for a given queue ID.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a lease, marking it as unassigned.

methods.name: SetQueuesAsLeases
methods.description: Initializes the lease map with a set of queue IDs.

methods.name: RecordBalancerResponsibility
methods.description: Records the responsibility of a balancer for a set of queues, used in testing.

methods.name: GetResponsibilityMap
methods.description: Returns the current responsibility map for balancers.
